record.question: While framing the Constitution of India, the provision of Federation was borrowed from the Constitution of which of the following countries:
record.explanation: Answer D: Canada. India’s federal system with a strong Centre is commonly attributed to the Canadian Constitution. Reference: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC Law & Judicial Paper-I, February 2026 examination; current officeholder/current affairs claims interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
